12	    sys.modules["contract_kit"] = kit
13	    spec.loader.exec_module(kit)

15	Then `kit.sample("core.RunSettings", "dqn_compact", RunSettings)` is a decoded sample,
16	`kit.fake("evaluate.evaluate").evaluate` the fixture-backed fake, and
17	`kit.env_double("core.Env", "corridor_goal")` a replay double of a recorded game.
18	
19	Arrays are stored as `{"dtype": ..., "shape": [...], "data": [...]}`.

23	import importlib.util
24	import json
25	import sys

36	CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

39	# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- folders and samples
40	def folder(name: str) -> Path:
41	    """The contract folder of `name`, e.g. `core.RunSettings`."""
42	    path = CONTRACTS / name
43	    if not path.is_dir():

48	def raw_samples(name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
49	    """Every JSON sample of `name`, by case name."""

51	    return {f.stem: json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for f in files}

54	def raw_sample(name: str, case: str) -> Any:

58	def sample(name: str, case: str, tp: Any) -> Any:
59	    """Sample `case` of `name`, decoded into `tp`."""

67	def fake(name: str) -> types.ModuleType:
68	    """The fixture-backed fake module of the function `name`."""
69	    path = folder(name) / "fake.py"
70	    module_name = f"contract_fake_{name.replace('.', '_')}"
71	    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, path)
72	    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
73	        raise LookupError(f"no fake for {name}")
74	    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
75	    sys.modules[module_name] = module
76	    spec.loader.exec_module(module)

80	# ------------------------------------------------------------------------ decoding and encoding
81	def decode(tp: Any, data: Any) -> Any:
82	    """`data` (parsed JSON) as an instance of the type `tp`; dataclass defaults fill gaps."""
83	    if tp is np.ndarray:
84	        return np.asarray(data["data"], dtype=data["dtype"]).reshape(data["shape"])
85	    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(tp) and isinstance(tp, type):
86	        hints = get_type_hints(tp)
87	        return tp(**{key: decode(hints[key], value) for key, value in data.items()})
88	    origin = get_origin(tp)
89	    if origin is not None:
90	        return _decode_generic(origin, get_args(tp), data)
91	    return _decode_scalar(tp, data)
92	
93	
94	def _decode_generic(origin: Any, args: tuple[Any, ...], data: Any) -> Any:
95	    if origin is Literal:
96	        if data not in args:
97	            raise ValueError(f"{data!r} is not one of {args}")
98	        return data
99	    if origin in {Union, types.UnionType}:
100	        inner = [a for a in args if a is not type(None)]
101	        return None if data is None and len(inner) < len(args) else decode(inner[0], data)
102	    if origin is tuple:
103	        if len(args) == 2 and args[1] is Ellipsis:
104	            args = (args[0],) * len(data)
105	        return tuple(decode(a, x) for a, x in zip(args, data, strict=True))
106	    if origin in {list, Sequence}:
107	        return [decode(args[0], x) for x in data]
108	    if origin in {dict, Mapping}:
109	        return {key: decode(args[1], value) for key, value in data.items()}
110	    raise TypeError(f"cannot decode {data!r} as {origin}")
111	
112	
113	def _decode_scalar(tp: Any, data: Any) -> Any:
114	    if tp is Any or (tp in {int, str, bool} and type(data) is tp):
115	        return data
116	    if tp is Path:
117	        return Path(data)
118	    if tp is float and isinstance(data, int | float) and not isinstance(data, bool):
119	        return float(data)
120	    raise TypeError(f"cannot decode {data!r} as {tp}")
121	
122	
123	def encode(value: Any) -> Any:
124	    """The JSON form `decode` reads back."""

169	def _check(s: dict[str, Any], data: Any, root: dict[str, Any], at: str) -> list[str]:
170	    if "$ref" in s:
171	        target: Any = root
172	        for part in s["$ref"].removeprefix("#/").split("/"):
173	            target = target[part]
174	        return _check(target, data, root, at)
175	    if "anyOf" in s:
176	        if any(not _check(option, data, root, at) for option in s["anyOf"]):
177	            return []
178	        return [f"{at}: matches none of anyOf"]
179	    errors: list[str] = []
180	    if "type" in s:
181	        names = s["type"] if isinstance(s["type"], list) else [s["type"]]
182	        if not any(_is_type(data, n) for n in names):
183	            return [f"{at}: expected {s['type']}, got {type(data).__name__}"]
184	    if "enum" in s and data not in s["enum"]:
185	        errors.append(f"{at}: {data!r} not in {s['enum']}")
186	    if "const" in s and data != s["const"]:
187	        errors.append(f"{at}: {data!r} != {s['const']!r}")
188	    if "minimum" in s and isinstance(data, int | float) and data < s["minimum"]:
189	        errors.append(f"{at}: {data} < {s['minimum']}")
190	    if "maximum" in s and isinstance(data, int | float) and data > s["maximum"]:
191	        errors.append(f"{at}: {data} > {s['maximum']}")
192	    if isinstance(data, dict):

194	    if isinstance(data, list):

203	    props = s.get("properties", {})
204	    extra = s.get("additionalProperties", True)
205	    for key, value in data.items():
206	        if key in props:
207	            errors += _check(props[key], value, root, f"{at}.{key}")
208	        elif extra is False:

210	        elif isinstance(extra, dict):

230	class EnvReplay:
231	    """A core.Env replaying one recorded game: `reset` returns the recorded start, and each
232	    `step` must get the recorded actions (`recorded_actions`), returning the recorded result."""
233	
234	    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
235	        self.teams: dict[str, TeamSpec] = decode(dict[str, TeamSpec], recording["teams"])
236	        self.board: Literal["grid", "tank"] = recording["board"]
237	        self.seed: int = recording["seed"]
238	        self._start = decode(dict[str, np.ndarray], recording["reset"]["obs"])
239	        self._info = decode(dict[str, float], recording["reset"]["info"])
240	        self._frames = [decode(np.ndarray, f) for f in recording["frames"]]
241	        self.recorded_actions: list[dict[str, np.ndarray]] = [
242	            decode(dict[str, np.ndarray], s["actions"]) for s in recording["steps"]
243	        ]
244	        self._results: list[StepResult] = [
245	            decode(StepResult, s["result"]) for s in recording["steps"]
246	        ]
247	        self.reset_seeds: list[int] = []
248	        self._t = -1
249	
250	    def reset(self, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]:
251	        self.reset_seeds.append(seed)
252	        self._t = 0
253	        return dict(self._start), dict(self._info)
254	
255	    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult:
256	        if self._t < 0 or self._t >= len(self._results):
257	            raise RuntimeError("step called before reset or after the game is over")
258	        expected = self.recorded_actions[self._t]
259	        if set(actions) != set(expected):
260	            raise ValueError(
261	                f"teams {sorted(actions)} differ from the recording's {sorted(expected)}"
262	            )
263	        for team, action in expected.items():
264	            if not np.array_equal(np.asarray(actions[team]), action):
265	                raise ValueError(f"step {self._t}: {team} actions differ from the recording")
266	        result = self._results[self._t]
267	        self._t += 1
268	        return result
269	
270	    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray:
271	        return self._frames[max(self._t, 0)]

274	class AgentReplay:
275	    """A core.Agent replaying recorded calls in order: each `act` must get the recorded
276	    observation and `explore`, and returns the recorded actions; each `learn` must get the
277	    recorded Transition. `calls` lists what it was asked."""
278	
279	    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
280	        self.team: TeamSpec = decode(TeamSpec, recording["team"])
281	        self._calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = recording["calls"]
282	        self._next = 0
283	        self.calls: list[str] = []
284	
285	    def _expect(self, method: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
286	        if self._next >= len(self._calls):
287	            raise RuntimeError(f"{method} called after the {len(self._calls)} recorded calls")
288	        call = self._calls[self._next]
289	        if call["method"] != method:
290	            raise ValueError(f"call {self._next}: {method}, but the recording has {call['method']}")
291	        self._next += 1
292	        self.calls.append(method)
293	        return call
294	
295	    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray:
296	        call = self._expect("act")
297	        if not np.array_equal(obs, decode(np.ndarray, call["obs"])) or explore != call["explore"]:
298	            raise ValueError(f"act {self._next - 1}: observation or explore differ")
299	        return decode(np.ndarray, call["returns"])
300	
301	    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None:
302	        call = self._expect("learn")
303	        recorded = decode(Transition, call["transition"])
304	        same = all(
305	            np.array_equal(getattr(t, f.name), getattr(recorded, f.name))
306	            for f in dataclasses.fields(Transition)
307	        )
308	        if not same:
309	            raise ValueError(f"learn {self._next - 1}: the transition differs from the recording")
310	
311	    def save(self, path: Path) -> None:
312	        path.write_text(json.dumps({"next": self._next}), encoding="utf-8")
313	        self.calls.append("save")
314	
315	    def load(self, path: Path) -> None:
316	        self._next = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["next"]
317	        self.calls.append("load")

"""Unit tests of the training loop on the core.Env / core.Agent replay doubles (M1-T06)."""

import dataclasses
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.core import RunSettings, Transition
from rllab.train import loop

KIT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "contracts" / "kit.py"
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("contract_kit", KIT_PATH)
assert _spec is not None
assert _spec.loader is not None
kit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
sys.modules["contract_kit"] = kit
_spec.loader.exec_module(kit)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit


class RightAgent:
    """Always steps right (action 1); keeps every Transition and `explore` flag it gets."""

    def __init__(self, interrupt_at: int = -1) -> None:
        self.transitions: list[Transition] = []
        self.explores: list[bool] = []
        self.interrupt_at = interrupt_at
        self.loaded: Path | None = None

    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray:
        self.explores.append(explore)
        return np.ones(len(obs), dtype=np.int64)

    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None:
        if len(self.transitions) == self.interrupt_at:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        self.transitions.append(t)

    def save(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.write_text("right", encoding="utf-8")

    def load(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.loaded = path


class Clock:
    """A monotonic clock that moves `dt` seconds on each reading."""

    def __init__(self, dt: float) -> None:
        self.t = 100.0
        self.dt = dt

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        self.t += self.dt
        return self.t


def corridor_settings(**changes: Any) -> RunSettings:
    base = kit.sample("core.RunSettings", "corridor_tabular", RunSettings)
    return dataclasses.replace(base, **changes)

    """`train` writing to an in-memory run writer and scoring with the evaluate fake."""

    env = kit.env_double("core.Env", "corridor_goal")
    agent = kit.agent_double("core.Agent", "tabular_corridor")
    settings = corridor_settings(steps=5, eval_every=2, eval_games=20)

) -> None:
